tasks.action: Modify _cheap_call() to retry up to 3 times with exponential backoff (delays: 0.5s, 1s, 2s) on any Exception. If all retries are exhausted, return empty string. Preserve all existing logging. Use time.sleep for delays.
tasks.interface_contract: Called internally by the orchestrator to make a low-cost LLM API call; returns the response string or empty string on total failure
constraints: Retry exactly 3 times maximum (attempts 1, 2, 3) before giving up
Backoff delays must be 0.5s before retry 1, 1.0s before retry 2, 2.0s before retry 3
Only catch Exception (or subclasses) to trigger a retry
If all 3 retries fail, return empty string ''
All existing logging calls inside _cheap_call must remain unchanged
Add a log message (e.g. logging.warning) on each retry attempt that includes the attempt number and the exception
import time must be present at the top of the file (add if missing)
must_not: Must not catch BaseException or bare except
Must not raise any exception out of _cheap_call after retries are exhausted
Must not alter any other method in the file
Must not use third-party retry libraries (e.g. tenacity)
Must not change the function signature
